integrations_researched.name: react-native-tvos

imports: hasTVPreferredFocus, isTVSelectable, tvParallaxProperties, nextFocusUp, nextFocusDown, nextFocusLeft, nextFocusRight
api_patterns.initialization: Platform.isTV checks for runtime detection, TVEventHandler for remote events
key_functions: TVEventHandler.enable(component, callback) - Listen to remote events
findNodeHandle(ref) - Get native node handle for focus control
setNativeProps({ hasTVPreferredFocus: true }) - Programmatically focus element

tv_specific_props.hasTVPreferredFocus: Boolean - Initial focus preference on screen mount
tv_specific_props.isTVSelectable: Boolean - Whether element is focusable (default true)
tv_specific_props.tvParallaxProperties: Object - Apple TV parallax effect config (tiltAngle, magnification, pressMagnification)
tv_specific_props.nextFocusUp: Number - Node handle to focus when pressing up
tv_specific_props.nextFocusDown: Number - Node handle to focus when pressing down
tv_specific_props.nextFocusLeft: Number - Node handle to focus when pressing left
tv_specific_props.nextFocusRight: Number - Node handle to focus when pressing right
tv_specific_props.onFocus: Function - Callback when element receives focus
tv_specific_props.onBlur: Function - Callback when element loses focus

config_files: app.json - ios.supportsTV: true for Apple TV support
app.json - android TV configuration via package settings

build_commands: npm run start:tv - Start Metro bundler in TV mode
npm run prebuild:tv - Prebuild native TV projects

gotchas: TVEventHandler may not be available in all Expo builds - must check if it exists before instantiation
hasTVPreferredFocus only works on initial mount - use setNativeProps for runtime focus changes
nextFocus* props require native node handles (from findNodeHandle), not refs directly
Platform.isTV returns true on both Apple TV and Android TV
Long-press detection differs between platforms: Android TV has 'longSelect' event, Apple TV requires custom timing
Focus navigation can create focus traps if nextFocus* props form circular dependencies
Metro bundler automatically loads .tv.tsx files on TV platforms (when APP_VARIANT=tv is set)

integrations_researched.name: React Navigation

api_patterns.initialization: NavigationContainer wraps app, navigators define screen structure
key_functions: useFocusEffect(callback) - Run effect when screen gains focus
navigation.addListener('focus', callback) - Listen to focus events

tv_specific_patterns.focus_memory: Use navigation.setParams() to store last focused item ID, restore on useFocusEffect
tv_specific_patterns.screen_options: Configure headerShown, gestureEnabled based on Platform.isTV
tv_specific_patterns.back_handling: Use navigation.addListener('beforeRemove') for custom back button behavior

api_patterns.verified_against: Project source code (AppNavigator.tsx), React Navigation v7 documentation

gotchas: useFocusEffect runs on every screen focus - must use useCallback to prevent infinite loops
Navigation state is lost on hot reload in development
Screen focus events may fire before layout is complete - use requestAnimationFrame for focus restoration
Deep linking requires additional configuration for TV platforms
Stack navigation animations may need to be disabled on TV for better performance

Some Android TV devices have poor animation performance - consider disabling on low-end devices

unverified_claims.claim: Voice search via TV remote is required
unverified_claims.reason: No existing implementation found in codebase. Requires native module development or Expo config plugin. Voice search APIs differ significantly between Apple TV (Siri) and Android TV (Voice Intent).
unverified_claims.recommendation: Consider deferring voice search to a future release. Requires significant native development effort. If needed, research expo-speech or custom native modules for voice input.

unverified_claims.claim: Long-press support for context menus is fully functional
unverified_claims.reason: Project has react-native-gesture-handler installed, but no evidence of long-press context menu implementation. Android TV supports native 'longSelect' event, but Apple TV requires custom timing via gesture handler.
unverified_claims.recommendation: Implement long-press detection using TVEventHandler for Android TV (longSelect event) and LongPressGestureHandler for Apple TV. Create reusable ContextMenu component.

unverified_claims.claim: Focus memory between screens is complete
unverified_claims.reason: TVNavigationContext has focus history tracking, but no evidence of screen-level focus restoration on navigation. React Navigation integration for focus memory needs to be implemented.
unverified_claims.recommendation: Implement focus memory using navigation params: store last focused item ID in route.params, restore on useFocusEffect. Add to Focusable component pattern.
